source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Back out near the edge of the forest Ephanna, Karesmine, Caelynn and Thrin continue to battle the swarm of red gnats.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Thrin, desperate to see something go in their favor, takes two more shots with his bow.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: The first misses, but the second does enough damage to knock a group of insects out of the swarm. Then the swarm turns and envelopes Caelynn, the rest of the team can only see her dim shadow under all the flying insects.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Thanks to her high constitution, she is able to withstand the stinging and only take minor damage.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna unleashes two Eldritch Blasts, the first missing and the second one dealing enough damage to knock another cluster out of the swarm.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: They Misty Step away and add some temporary health to themselves.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Now that the swarm is around Caelynn, Karsemine is able to use her scimitar and short sword for a series of attacks, landing 4 hits on the swarm.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: She also uses Zephyr Strike to increase her movement and dash away.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Finally Caelynn is able to duck out of the swarm, then facing them, casts a powerful Thunderwave spell, splitting the swarm in two and pushing it back 10 feet.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: As Thrin and Caelynn move back the swarm finally gives up and heads back into the forest.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: The team decides they have enough "testing" and should head back to tell the others what they discovered.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Back in town, Bonogo is being guided by Stuart down an alley to a half burned building.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: According to Stuart this is where they will find Stacey.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: As soon as they step inside the large warehouse they find a group of children formed into two groups with what appear to be the leaders arguing in the middle.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: One of them is Stacey, the bugbear girl they are looking for.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: She is in a heated argument with the other children who are accusing her of continuing to be too bossy.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo whispers into Stuart's ear, "you know what to do" then sends him over.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Stacey immediately gets upset at seeing Stuart and tells him that he can't play with them, but Stuart is undeterred.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: He sticks his hand out and demands his gold back, convinced that she is the one that stole it.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Stuart takes a quick glance at Bonogo before he pulls out the dart and threatens her with it.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Alarmed, she yells at Stuart and then throws her gold pouch at him before storming out the door.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Stuart is so happy with the outcome that he runs out the door, racing off to tell his mom the good news.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: The other kids now ask Bonogo to play with them instead.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: He agrees to play hide and seek as long as the kids hide first.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: He counts to 20 then leaves the building without making a sound.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: He is intent on following Stacey and catches up to her in the next alley.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: After seeing no one else around, he quickly grabs her and puts a knife to her throat.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: He tells her to stop bullying Stuart or he will come back, then dashes into the shadows.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Clearly shaken, Stacey runs home.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo makes his way back to the group out in the field.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: As the group approaches the preparations happening in the field, they find Stafl singing and directing the workers from a makeshift throne of barrels on the back of a wagon.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna, Karesmine and Caelynn relay their findings from their tests: do not attack the trees directly, but the forest should respond to changes on the ground.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo takes up a supervisor role and is observing the work when he hears footsteps quickly approaching behind him.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: He is able to dodge a slap from a furious Bugbear woman.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Even with the missed slap, she gets up into Bonogo's face and begins to berate him for encouraging Stuart to harass her daughter, causing many of the workers to stop and watch.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo tries to shift the situation and asks why she is not helping with the ditches and should get to work instead.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: This, of course, only makes her more furious.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: She stands up to her full Bugbear height and begins to scream at him.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: She finds just the right words to cut deep: he smells like a circus animal.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Stafl takes a look around at the crowd to gauge their reactions.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: A farmer whispers to him that Stafl better step in and help because Marla is not someone to mess with.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: They reveal that she is in charge of the workers in town and she means business.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo continues to escalate the situation, telling Marla he sees where her daughter gets her attitude from.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Marla then grapples Bonogo and is about to do much worse when Caelynn comes to the rescue.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Using her bracelet she is able to diffuse the aggression and get everyone back to work, united against the approaching forest.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: The rest of the Questionable Company decide to take a short rest as their final preparation.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Questionable Company, along with the townsfolk, watch as the forest comes within range of their plan.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: As the forest finally reaches the fortifications, the fires are lit in the ditches.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Immediately they can all see the trees pull back and then start to turn to the east, away from the town.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Cheers go up along the ditches and into town.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: The mayor and sheriff congratulate the heroes and thank them again for all their help.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Marla approaches Caelynn and asks her how she should deal with Bonogo, but Ephanna quickly intervenes, letting her, and the town, know that the Questionable Company is leaving town to continue their journey.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: And now that the danger has passed Caelynn asks the mayor about Lysandra, but finds out that they have never heard of her.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn quickly pulls out the "rockie-talkie" and attempts to call Lysandra.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: After a brief pause she is connected with the familiar voice of Sara, one half of the operators in Mirathorn.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn relays her request and Sara calls Lysandra.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: She tells Caelynn that all she could hear was mumbling about the forest leaving and that something strange happened to the time.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Sara then connects Caelynn directly to Lysandra who is relieved and overjoyed that the group is ok and that they took care of the forest.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn wants to know if she is ok and where she is.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Lysandra tells her that she can't remember much after the group left, only that she decided to go around the forest and she could smell meat while trying to sleep.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: She is exhausted and disoriented.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn tells her to stop where she is and make a camp and rest, Karesmine will lead the team to her.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Using her extensive tracking skills, Karesmine is able to estimate the distance and direction that Lysandra may have traveled.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: The group sets off from the town, Ephanna keeping a close eye on Thrin.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Thirty minutes later they come across an unusual sight: a wagon partly unloaded and horses wandering around a stack of crates.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn approaches the makeshift shelter and hears mumbling from inside.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: She finds Lysandra drawing in the dirt.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: She says it is a tower where the voices are coming from and she knows where it is.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: The first thing Caelynn notices about Lysandra is that her eyes are shimmery, just like the members of the cult.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: She quickly begins to make the antidote from the tea in her bag.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: While the tea is being prepared, Caelynn takes a closer look at the drawing.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: It appears to be a top-down blueprint of a tower and is very well done.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Finally, after drinking the tea, Lysandra comes out of the spell.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: She is very confused, wondering where she is and how she got there.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: All that she is able to remember is voices in the dark after the group left into the forest.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Back outside, Karesmine is rounding up the horses and making sure they are properly taken care of.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: She can see that the storm is still building in the distance, but will soon be upon the camp.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Stafl starts sorting through the provisions, convinced that someone snuck in the tainted meat before leaving Mirathorn.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: With a huge sigh of relief he finds the bacon untouched, however the other crates of jerky did not fare as well.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Mixed in with the meat is cleverly disguised tainted meat.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Not being able to separate the good from the bad, the whole thing will have to be burned.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn calls Sara to tell her the good news about Lysandra, and bad news about the tainted meat.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Sara is very concerned about who she can now trust in the city.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: She transfers Caelynn to Professor Tealeaf, but she doesn't pick up.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn continues to wait on the line for an answer from Tealeaf as the rest of the group set up a proper camp for a rest.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: They need to set up a shelter for the animals and themselves as it is clear the storm is approaching and Karesmine can see it is bringing the magical shimmering rain.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 20 - Gnat Swarm Marla Lysandra.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna plans to create a disguise and go back to town for new supplies, but for the moment the group is settling in for a rest around the camp.
